segments.contextAfter: [`MDLLightType.discArea`](mdllighttype/discarea.md): The light is shaped like a circle or ellipse in the xy-plane of its local coordinate space. If the [`aspect`](mdlarealight/aspect.md) value is `1.0`, the [`areaRadius`](mdlarealight/arearadius.md) value is the circle’s radius.
